title: Launcher source separation: private core stripped from public repo
desc: wkappbot-sdk csharp/src stripped to Launcher+Shared+Abstractions only. CLI/Core/WebBot/Win32/KiwoomProxy/Report removed. All workflows updated to fetch core binary from GitHub Release instead of building from source.
steps: Removed: WKAppBot.CLI WKAppBot.Core WKAppBot.WebBot WKAppBot.Win32 WKAppBot.KiwoomProxy WKAppBot.Report (554 files). Kept: WKAppBot.Launcher Shared WKAppBot.Abstractions
build.yml core fetch pattern: add env WKAPPBOT_CORE_PAT secret + step 'Download core binary' using gh release download from kiexpert/wkappbot latest release
Reverting separation: git revert c3b2ec61 restores all private source. Only do this if private source must temporarily re-appear for debugging -- never push revert to public repo
Post-separation checklist: verify release.yml can fetch core artifact, run extended-smoke against downloaded binary, confirm tests.yml no-op doesn't block merge

requirements.expect: Version field (wkappbot still running after separation)
